results.title: Prime Video Black Friday AMC+ & MGM+ Bundle Deal for $3.49/month for 2 months + free shipping w/ Prime
results.description: Prime Video takes 75% off its AMC+ and MGM+ streaming bundle during its Black Friday Sale, dropping the price to $3.49/month (regularly $13.99/month) for two months. AMC+ features programming such as Kill Jackie, Yaga, Irish Blood, and Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches, while MGM+ offers titles including Project Hail Mary, The Institute, Treasure Island, and American Hostage. The bundle returns to its regular monthly price after the promotional period. This deal ends November 30.
